༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs

so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rnal 'byor pa gang zhig 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar spro na/ brtag gnyis las/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang*// de bzhin du ni brgyad pa nyid// ces dang*/ de nyid las/ zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*// khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang*// yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la| |mchod pa mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar gyi tshes brgyad/ bcu/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga/ mar gyi nyer gsum/ nyer lnga/ nyer dgu/ gnam stong gang yang rung ba ni dus kyi mchod pa yin la/ dus ma yin pa glo bur du bya ba ni/ de nyid las/ 'chi ba'i tshe'am mu ge'am// phas kyi 'khor lo'i gnod pa dang*// rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang*// char ba med dang zhi ba la// sngags dang sgom par ldan pa yis// gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol ba// de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste// der ni rdzun du mi 'gyur ro| |zhes gsungs pa ste/ rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba'i mtshan ma byung ba'i tshe de bslu ba'am/ yul khams su mu ge byung ba sel ba'am/ pha rol gyi dmag dang byad phur zlog pa'am/ rab gnas kyi dus sam/ dbang bskur ba'i dus sam/ sbyin sreg gi dus sam/ char dbab pa'am/ nad la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i ched la sogs par yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba yin no// gnas ni dur khrod dam/ shing gcig gam/ chu 'gram la sogs pa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ khyad par du mi la sogs pa'i 'grim lam med pa nyid du bya ste/ ji skad du/ mtshan mo skye bo med khyim du| |zhes dus ni mtshan mo bya bar gsungs so// de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bkram pa'i mdun du/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang pos byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkram/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rnams g.yon skor du bshams/

rnal 'byor ni 'khor lo sdom pa'i bdag mdun gang yang rung ba 'dir sbyar rung la/ 'dir ni lnga ldan gyi rgyun 'khyer 'khrul med snying po la sbyar bas/ de'i sangs rgyas chos tshogs nas/ dbang lha rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ dbang rgyas pa'i mal du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa sogs rgyun 'khyer ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o// mthar thun bsdus nas phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang gi nga rgyal bzung yab kyi go cha drug bgo/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ri rab chen po'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje ye shes kyi me'i gur khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la hūm̐ nag po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa nag po'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po zhes pa nas/ 'od zer lnga 'phro ba zhes pa'i bar rgyun 'khyer ltar dang*/

phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la ro'i gdan la mdun du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ g.yon du lā ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ga'ang spyan gsum skra grol thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ cung zad khro ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhi'i 'dab ma la rtag pa sogs rgyal ba bzhi'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi lngas bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa gnas pa'o// 'bar ba'i rgya smin mtshams su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ waṃ she= mṛ taṃ ge= mu rañdze= hā s+ya= lā s+ya= gī ti= nṛ t+yai= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= dī pe= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa| oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ra sa= spar+she= oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/

oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs gong ltar la/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa rnams sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ wa raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa bcas phyi'i mchod pa'o// nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa 'og gi tshogs byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'bul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa// dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*// til+li pa dang nā ro kar+ṇa ri// rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// rtswa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa// chos rje spyan snga bcu gnyis dbang bsod pa// grags pa shes rab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba// 'dren mchog bla ma blo bzang rin bzang zhabs// bsod nams bkra shis rje btsun rat+na'i mtshan// chos kyi rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// dngos grub rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab yum gyi sngags bzhi'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharma pā la ma hā kā lā tsa tur+hasta ma hā kā lī dharma tā re sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag 'gro drug gi sems can dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po'i lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul zhing rang gi myang ba nang mchod/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/

nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan zhing bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze'u 'bru as mtshan zhing rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par bab pas dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'| lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes rtse mor son pa'i tshe 'pho med du bcing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gyen du drangs pa'i tshe lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar byas pa gsang mchod/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /rang bzhin med cing dag pa'i dngos// mchod bya mchod byed de kho na// mtha' bral zung 'jug bde ba che// zhes don dran pa de kho na'i mchod pa/ rdor dril 'dzin pas rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros| mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spros te khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhar byas te tshur 'dus de nyid la thim par bsam zhing*/ yab yum gyi sngags ci 'grub bzla/ 'khor so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su ḍaṃ laṃ khaṃ raṃ rnams kyi mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las lha'i rnam pa spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus de nyid la thim par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| lā me= khaṇ+ḍa ro he= oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci 'grub bzlas/ spro na 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i gtor ma gzhan ltar dbul/ mi spro na mi dgos/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni rang gi mdun du zhing lpags sam| gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba sha zan la sogs g.yas dang*/

shes rab kyi rdzas skyes pa'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa ma da nas bkang ba g.yon du bsham/ gzhan bza' btung ci 'byor pa'ang bsham/ sha chang med du mi rung ste/ he badz+ra las/ rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun dang*// lan bdun pa yang bza' bar bya// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig pa/ chang ni bzang pos bkang byas te// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ sha ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i ched du bsad pa log 'tsho dang*/ bza' btung gzhan rnams kyang kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid du 'du bya'o// de las tshogs rdzas rnams la sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas sbags/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil nang mchod kyis chag chag btab par 'bru tshom lnga bkod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ mdun nas g.yon skor du/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa las dpa' mo drug dang*/ mthe bong nas sor mo rnams la rim gyis oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ las dpa' bo drug /bol gong du lha lnga sor mo me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu khams lnga lha mo lngar gsal bar gyur par bsam/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod la/ oṃ baṃ sogs drug gis bdud rtsi thigs gtor dang*/ oṃ ha sogs drug gis sha zan dum gcig lag pa'i lhar dbul/ thal mo sbyar te/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes thal mo gnas gsum du reg /sha zan dum re tshogs la bsre/ tshogs rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ lho ru ku las khyi'i sha rnams kyi steng du māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ/

slar yang de dag gi steng gi dbus su mū las dri chu/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las go ro tsa na/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i tshe nyes skyon thams cad lbu ba'i tshul du phyir lud/ bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char ka lta bu'i kha dog can gyi kha gcod zla ba'i rnam pa'i dbus rlangs pa las grub pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha 'og tu blta ba'i rtse mo dang sked pa yu ba'i rtse mo rnams su hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ zla ba'i steng du a ā nas/ ha k+ṣaḥdakar dmar dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros pa dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gyur pa sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus pa dbyangs gsal zla ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yi ge gsum dang bcas par thim pas/ de rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu ba thod pa'i rdzas dang dbyer med du 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ tshogs rnams kyi phud maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du dbul zhing*/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min gnas mchog dam pa nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /bde stong zung 'jug pho brang nas// bde chen 'khor lo dam pa'i tshogs// sa 'og sa steng sa bla nas// 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams// grong dang nye ba'i grong mtha' nas// dam tshig 'khor lo 'bar ba'i tshogs// dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal chen nas// dpal mgon dam pa bya rog mtshan// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma dang*// phyi nang gsang gsum dkyil 'khor nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren na// 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di// a la la te dgyes par rol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*// bsam don chos bzhin myur 'grub cing*// tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod sogs// mthun pa'i dpal rnams rgyas par mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// sems can thams cad bde ba dang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho myur skem zhing*// bla med byang chub thob par mdzod| |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba bī ra yo gi nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes 'bul/ kye/ tshogs khang pho brang o rgyan gnas| |tshogs mgron dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la// snod rnams pad+ma bhañdza nyid// bcud rnams ye shes bdud rtsi ste// bcos pa'i shes rab ma da na// dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs| |spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga bza' ba'i tshogs// thabs shes maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /dbang lnga keng rus bde stong du// byin brlabs spyad pas longs sku thob// byang sems rkang khu zhag rak+ta// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /zho sha la sogs dam rdzas tshogs// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /dkar gsum mngar gsum zag med kyi// bdud rtsir byin rlobs spyad pa yis// skye med rtogs par mdzad du gsol// 'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas 'khor 'das myang 'das kyi| |yon tan ma lus thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐// oṃ las 'od 'phros zhe sdang las// gyur pa'i tshogs rdzas dkar ba'i bcud// bde chen skur gyur longs spyad pas// nyams rtogs 'brel zhing mnar sems dang*// zhe sdang byams pa chen por gyur// āḥlas 'od 'phros 'dod chags las// gyur pa'i tshogs rdzas dmar ba'i mdangs// 'gag med gsung sgrog 'di spyad pas// gsung gis 'gro sgrol zag bcas kyi// bde ba zag med nyid gyur cig /hūm̐ las 'od 'phros gti mug las// gyur pa'i tshogs rdzas mthing 'od 'bar| |chos sku'i rdzas 'di longs spyad pas// sems dang ye shes 'brel gyur cig /gti mug 'od gsal chen por gyur// ye shes lnga ldan rtog bral gyi// lnga rdzogs bcud 'di rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams// dgyes par rol la bdag cag gi// sgo gsum phung khams skye mched rnams// sku lnga ye shes lngar byin rlobs// sgo gsum sku gsum rdo rje gsum// ma thob de srid bar chad rnams// srung zhing byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol// phyi nang bar chad rab bsal nas// mchog thun 'bras bu deng stsol cig

/ces brjod tshogs spel/ las kyi rdo rjes g.yas ma da na thogs/ g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i rgya bstan la/ mthong ba'i chos kun dag pa la// med do snyam pa'i rtog pa spongs// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa bcas// lhan cig gcig pa nyid du rol// zhes drangs/ len pa pos/ bde gshegs chos ni dag pa ste// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces rnam lnga'i 'dod kor gyis blangs/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal pa'i tshul spangs te/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas longs spyad/ lha rnams tshim pa'i sems kyis rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ mahāsukhashaṃnartalalita/ ut+tamayogipad+makaṃ/ alalalalalaho/ hikaṃsaṃyogipūdzakuruḥ a.ī.ā.āralihoḥ sushaṃnāthakaṃtiṣ+ṭhan+tuḥ ḍākidzālakaṃshaṃkuruḥ ainartas+yanartakar/ mamamahāshaṃprayats+tsha/ mok+ṣawādibs/ alalalalalahoḥ saṃno.ayuk+ta.akaṃ/ ashaṃsnoyuk+ti/ shaṃbhagas+thānaṃ/ saṃ.ibasnobartita/ mahāshaṃyuk+takuruḥ pad+mabharas/ bh+ramaraiwaṃshaṃkuruḥ shaṃsaṃpan+nakhawādi/ a.ishubhatsit+ta/ tshamok+ṣakhaprap+ta/ saṃpan+na sid+dhi kur+wan+tuḥ zhes brjod/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mgron du dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa/ dam tshig gcig pa ma gtogs phal pa gzhan gyis ma mthong bar bya/ tshogs la rang dga'i ngo 'dzin dang phal gyi mgron gyi 'du shes can gyi mgron dang rnyed brtson mi bya/ tshogs kyi yo byad gzhan du khyer nas skyes ma ster ba dang gsog 'jog mi bya ba sogs tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig las ma 'gal ba gal che'o// de ma thag dam tshig gcig pa kho na'i lhag ma bsdus pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag pa 'bar ba'i rgya kha'i thad du bcas pa'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes lhag ma gtsang sar phul/ mdun bskyed la chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/

bstod cing yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ shis brjod dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya'o// smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsang ba'i lam// rdo rje theg pa las gsungs pa// rdo rje can gyi tshogs 'khor lo// rdo rje bza' ba'i dam tshig yin// bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga// stobs bcu mngon shes lnga la sogs// da lta nyid du 'grub pa'i rgyu// yin mod 'on kyang nyan thos dang*// rtog ges thos na rna ba 'gebs// rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad// ji bzhin shes pa dka' mod kyi// 'on kyang de dag ma shes na// rdo rje slob dpon gzugs brnyan yin// de phyir zab mo'i lam mang po// rtogs pas rdo rje 'dzin pa ngas// rdo rje theg pa'i srol 'ga' 'ga'// 'di las gzhan du mang phye lo// 'on kyang gsang ba'i theg mchog gi// bstan pa bgres por gyur dus 'dir// don gnyer nyin skar ji bzhin bas// de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya tshul shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ lcam zhabs drung gi bkas bskul ba las/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du mgyogs par bris pa'i dge bas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du rgyas pa dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
